description: Real-time web search and content retrieval - up to 10 results with title, URL, snippet and publish date, plus clean full-page Markdown for the top 3 results by default and an optional short summary. Also accepts up to 5 queries in one call, merged and de-duplicated - one call instead of five. No account, no API key, no quota. Try GET /search/sample. Part of the AgentIndex content kit (pdf, web-read, extract, summarize, detect-language) - see GET /capabilities.
